subject: Re: Marketplace private offer pricing & unit-price mapping (AWS / GCP / Azure) - Brightcart
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@brightcart.com>, Tom Nguyen <tomnguyen@amazon.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@gcp-partners.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace private offer pricing & unit-price mapping (AWS / GCP / Azure) - Brightcart

Thanks again for the call this morning  good sync. Quick recap and next steps so everyone's aligned.

Call highlights:
- Brightcart shared expected token profile: baseline ~150M tokens / month, seasonal peaks up to ~1B tokens (Black Friday / promos).
- Brightcart is evaluating launching via AWS Marketplace private offer first, with GCP/Azure follow-up later this year.
- Procurement asked for a mapping from our list price (per 1M tokens) to the unit-price fields required by each marketplace (AWS: price per 1k tokens edge case; GCP: price per 1M; Azure: price per 1000 tokens). Also need a private-offer SKU/unit price suggestion that factors marketplace fees.

Our asks / proposals:
1) Confirm Brightcart target blended unit economics: you said target end-customer spend target of ~$20-25 per 1M tokens (net to Brightcart). Can you confirm the exact target so we can map to Marketplace unit price?
2) Proposed Redwood list price: $20 / 1M tokens (our public hosted list). For Marketplace private offers we typically add a marketplace fee buffer (example: +10-15%) to compensate for fees and billing rounding.
3) Example mapping (please confirm):
   - Redwood list: $20 / 1M tokens
   - AWS Marketplace private offer unit price (AWS prefers price per 1k tokens): $0.022 per 1k tokens => equates to $22 / 1M tokens (includes ~10% buffer for marketplace fees).
   - GCP Marketplace: $22 / 1M tokens (set directly per 1M).
   - Azure Marketplace (if price requires per 1000 tokens): $0.022 per 1k tokens.
4) To model net economics for Brightcart we need to know whether Brightcart will absorb marketplace fees or pass them through to customers. If Brightcart wants target $/1M = $20 net, then Redwood's private-offer unit price needs to be adjusted to cover fee delta.

Attachments: I've attached a draft "marketplace_pricing_matrix.xlsx" that shows the per-marketplace unit-price conversions, example invoices, and a 12-month token volume sensitivity model. Also attached Redwood pricing terms for quick internal review.

Next steps / owners:
- Emma (Brightcart): confirm final target $/1M tokens (net to Brightcart) and whether you absorb marketplace fees or expect Redwood to net them out.
- Tom (AWS): confirm marketplace fee percentage you expect on private offers and any required SKU/unit-price formatting constraints.
- Sarah (GCP): if GCP requires a seller-managed monthly billing SKU, confirm the recommended unit granularity and invoicing cadence.
- Aditya / Camila (Redwood): we'll produce a final unit-price mapping file and a draft private-offer PO that Brightcart can sign.

Thanks  I can jump on a short follow-up tomorrow if useful.

Best,
Marissa
VP, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Nguyen <tomnguyen@amazon.com>

Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer pricing & unit-price mapping (AWS / GCP / Azure) - Brightcart

Thanks Marissa - quick clarifying notes from the AWS Marketplace side.

- Fees: private offers go through our Marketplace billing flow. Typical marketplace take rate for SaaS/private offers is ~12-15%, but this can vary by agreement and channel. For modeling, plan for 15% as conservative.
- Unit granularity: AWS allows per-1M or per-1k pricing. For in-product metering we commonly see per-1k tokens because customers and sellers like smaller increments for UI display.
- Rounding: AWS will round to the nearest cent on invoice lines; if you price per-1k at very small fractions, test rounding impact at your target volumes (I've seen rounding cost 0.2-1% in some high-volume deals).

If you want, I can loop in our Marketplace pricing specialist to review the attached matrix.

Tom
AWS Marketplace - Partner Sales

From: Emma Zhao <emma.zhao@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Nguyen <tomnguyen@amazon.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@gcp-partners.com>

Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer pricing & unit-price mapping (AWS / GCP / Azure) - Brightcart

Thanks - quick answers from our side:

- Brightcart target net to us is $20 / 1M tokens. We prefer to keep price to end-customer simple (we don't want to add an extra line item). So Brightcart will expect Redwood to set the private-offer unit price such that Brightcart nets $20 / 1M after marketplace fees.
- Expected volumes: baseline 150M / month; Q4 can spike to 900M-1B. We need predictable unit economics for FY27 planning.
- We prefer AWS private offer first. GCP/Azure can mirror pricing but we may negotiate slightly different margins on each platform.

Action items for Redwood: please provide a final unit-price mapping that nets Brightcart $20 / 1M after marketplace fees (use Tom's 15% as conservative fee estimate). Also include rounding/cent impact at our baseline 150M and peak 1B volumes.

Emma
Director, Partnerships & Procurement
Brightcart Inc

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace private offer pricing & unit-price mapping (AWS / GCP / Azure) - Brightcart

Forwarding to confirm numbers before I send the customer-facing unit-price sheet. Quick calc: if Brightcart needs $20 net / 1M and marketplace fee is 15%, the gross private-offer price needs to be:
- Gross = Net / (1 - fee) = $20 / 0.85 = $23.529... => round up to $23.53 / 1M tokens.
- For AWS per-1k SKU that is $0.02353 per 1k tokens. To avoid cent rounding issues at high volume, we should suggest a friendly per-1k price of $0.0236 (which maps to $23.60 / 1M).

I'll prep the final matrix:
- AWS private offer: $0.0236 per 1k tokens (listed price) => $23.60 / 1M => Brightcart nets ~$20.06 after 15% fee.
- GCP private offer: $23.60 / 1M.
- Azure: $0.0236 per 1k tokens.

I'll attach the updated marketplace_pricing_matrix.xlsx and include a 12-month P&L showing baseline and peak rounding impact. If Marissa approves, I'll send to Emma + Tom as the finalized ask.

Aditya
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
